title: Changes
info: A physical change alters shape, size, or state, but it is still the same stuff. Tearing paper and melting ice are physical changes.
A chemical change makes new stuff. Baking a cake and rust forming on iron are chemical changes.

options: a chemical change that makes metal
only a paint color you can peel with no new stuff
makes new substances, so it is a chemical change

questions.q: A clue of a chemical change can be
options: a new color, a gas, or heat that the materials themselves produce
pouring water into a larger cup

questions.q: Type the change that makes new substances.
